name: monday.com
description_en:
monday.com provides several cloud products; this catalog record focuses on monday work management and the shared board model used to organize project work. A board contains groups, rows called items, detail columns and subitems. The team chooses what an item means and builds its ownership, dates and status around that meaning.

That flexibility makes configuration part of adoption. A board that looks like a plan can still have missing dates, an unsuitable visibility type or automation that has failed. The sections below follow one small project through those decisions and separate work-management conditions from CRM and dev packaging. This is public-documentation research, not a hands-on evaluation.
description_zh:
monday.com 提供多种云产品；本档案聚焦 monday work management，以及用于组织项目工作的共享看板模型。看板由分组、称为 item 的行、明细列和子项组成。团队需要定义一行代表什么，再围绕该含义设置责任、日期与状态。

灵活性也意味着配置属于采用过程的一部分。看起来像计划的看板，仍可能缺少日期、采用不合适的可见性类型，或存在自动化失败。以下围绕一个小项目检查这些决定，并区分工作管理与 CRM、dev 套餐条件。本文是公开文档研究，没有实际操作测评。

core_features.explanation_en: Organize work as groups, items, columns and subitems.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以分组、条目、列和子项组织工作。

core_features.explanation_zh: 基于已有日期／时间线列选择 Flexible、Strict 或 No action。

core_features.explanation_en: Inspect run details and recent success, failure and action use.
core_features.explanation_zh: 检查运行明细及近期成功、失败与动作使用。

en: Coordinate a website release with explicit owners, dates and acceptance.
Share a client-facing board with a tested guest view.
zh: 用明确的负责人、日期和验收协调网站发布。
在测试访客视图后共享面向客户的看板。

Product scope.en: monday work management/shared board platform; CRM and dev entitlements not merged.
Product scope.zh: monday work management／共享看板平台；不合并 CRM 和 dev 权益。

Deployment.zh: 适用订阅条款的云服务。

steps.en: Define what an item means; add owner, status and existing dates, then test access.
steps.zh: 定义条目含义，添加负责人、状态和实际日期，再测试访问。

steps.en: Run a small representative handoff and inspect its history and destination before scaling.
steps.zh: 先运行小规模代表性交接，检查历史与目标，再扩大使用。

integrations.scope: Provider rate limits and separate third-party terms apply; no connector mapping or recovery tested.

items.en: Dependencies shift existing dates and have batch/summary-column restrictions.
items.zh: 依赖只移动已有日期，并有批量操作／汇总列限制。

items.en: Deleting or archiving a board removes connected-board relationships.
items.zh: 删除或归档看板会移除关联看板关系。

license.scope: Hosted platform rights, not independent SDK or third-party component licenses.

sections.title_en: Define a row before adding more views
sections.title_zh: 增加视图前先定义一行的含义
sections.en:
For a hypothetical website release, let one item represent a deliverable such as copy review, implementation or acceptance. Use groups to organize stages, columns for owner/date/status and subitems for the smaller checks that belong to that deliverable. Keep discussion with the item so its context follows the work.

Create this narrow board manually or use an import/template as a starting point. A generated structure still needs review against the team’s actual vocabulary. Before expanding it, ask two participants to update the same item and explain what Done means; inconsistent row semantics make later reports hard to interpret.
sections.zh:
假设准备网站发布，可以让一行代表文案审阅、实现或验收等交付项，用分组组织阶段，用列记录负责人／日期／状态，用子项列出属于该交付项的小检查。讨论应与具体条目放在一起，让背景跟随工作。

可以手动创建小看板，也可从导入或模板开始；生成结构仍需按团队实际术语复核。扩展前，建议让两位参与者更新同一条目，并解释 Done 的含义。行的语义不一致，会让后续报告难以解读。

sections.title_en: Choose board access for the intended audience
sections.title_zh: 按预期参与者选择看板访问
sections.en:
Main boards expose work to account team members, including viewers. Shareable boards invite external guests to specific boards and are documented for Standard and above. Private boards are for invited internal users on Pro/Enterprise; guests cannot be invited to them. Enterprise administrators may still see high-level private/shareable board metadata in the content directory.

For a client acceptance workflow, check the guest view of a shareable board rather than using a private board and expecting an external invitation to work. Keep confidential internal notes outside that shared audience. Board owners control type changes; role and plan both matter.
sections.zh:
Main 看板向账户团队成员开放，包括查看者。Shareable 看板把外部访客邀请到特定看板，文档列为 Standard 及以上可用。Private 看板供 Pro／Enterprise 中获邀的内部用户使用，不能邀请访客；Enterprise 管理员仍可在内容目录看到私有／共享看板的高层元数据。

如果需要客户验收，应检查 Shareable 看板的访客视图，不能建立 Private 看板后假设外部邀请可用。内部保密记录应放在该共享受众之外。看板所有者控制类型切换，角色与套餐都影响访问。

sections.title_en: A dependency needs existing dates and an explicit mode
sections.title_zh: 依赖需要已有日期及明确模式
sections.en:
On Pro/Enterprise, add the Dependency Column and choose a Date or Timeline column. Flexible mode moves dependent dates to avoid overlap, Strict reflects the predecessor’s exact time shift, and No action displays relations without shifting dates. The guide permits one Dependency Column per board.

Dependencies do not fill blank dates. In the release example, set review and implementation dates first, then move the predecessor and inspect the dependent result. Summary columns for subitems are unsupported here; batch date/timeline changes are restricted except in No action mode. Do not interpret an arrow as proof that every bulk edit will reschedule correctly.
sections.zh:
在 Pro／Enterprise 中添加 Dependency Column，并选择 Date 或 Timeline 列。Flexible 调整依赖日期以避免重叠，Strict 按前置项的时间变化量调整，No action 仅显示关系而不移日期。指南说明每块看板只能添加一列依赖。

依赖不会填充空白日期。对于发布样例，应先填审阅和实现日期，再移动前置项并检查后续结果。此处不支持子项汇总列；除 No action 外，批量修改日期／时间线也受限制。依赖箭头不能证明每次批量编辑都会正确重排。

sections.title_en: Inspect the run before repeating a status change
sections.title_zh: 重复改状态前先检查自动化运行
sections.en:
A suggested pilot is to notify a reviewer when an item becomes Ready. Open the automation’s Run History to check the affected item and initiator, then inspect recent success, failure and action-use analytics. A visible Ready label does not itself prove the notification arrived.

The management guide says reaching the monthly action limit may temporarily block editing, including switching an automation off. Define ownership before scaling a recipe and monitor usage while testing it. This profile did not run the example or confirm notification delivery.
sections.zh:
建议的试点是：条目变为 Ready 时通知审阅人。应在自动化 Run History 检查受影响条目和触发人，再查看近期成功、失败及动作使用分析。看到 Ready 标签本身，不能证明通知已经送达。

管理指南说明，达到月动作上限可能临时阻止编辑，包括关闭自动化。扩大配方使用前应定义负责人，并在测试时监控用量。本次没有实际运行样例或确认通知投递。

sections.title_en: Monthly allowance is separate from burst capacity
sections.title_zh: 月额度与突发处理能力分别判断
sections.en:
Automation limits also apply per minute at recipe, board and account levels. The rate-limit guide distinguishes throttling, where work may slow, from blocking, where new triggers/actions are rejected until reset. Integration limits may come from the connected provider.

Complexity limits can delay or cancel actions, so a delayed run should not be assumed to replay successfully. Investigate loops, API/webhook bursts and large batch operations in history before sending more changes. Reduce the pilot batch, inspect its output and check the external destination. No throughput or recovery guarantee was measured here.
sections.zh:
自动化还在配方、看板和账户层面执行每分钟限制。限流指南区分 throttle（可能变慢）和 block（重置前拒绝新触发／动作）；集成限制也可能来自外部服务。

复杂度限制可能延迟或取消动作，因此不能假设延迟运行一定成功重放。继续发送变化前，应通过历史检查循环、API／webhook 突发和大批量操作。建议缩小试点批次，检查结果及外部目标。本次未测量吞吐或恢复保证。

sections.title_en: Check board capacity and connections before cleanup
sections.title_zh: 清理前检查看板容量与连接
sections.en:
The item guide states a limit of 10,000 items per board, or 100,000 on Enterprise. Its separate CRM Enterprise beta allowance is not applied to this work-management scope. Plan-level “unlimited items” should therefore not be read as an infinite single board.

Deleted boards can be retrieved from Trash for thirty days; archived boards remain in archives indefinitely. However, the board guide says deleting or archiving removes its Connect Boards relationships. For a pilot, map linked reports before cleanup and verify the intended result on a disposable example. Archiving a source is not a promise that every connected report will keep working.
sections.zh:
条目指南说明，单块看板上限为 10,000 项，Enterprise 为 100,000 项。其另列的 CRM Enterprise 测试版额度不用于本档案的工作管理范围。因此，套餐级“不限量条目”不能解读为单块看板无限容量。

删除看板可在三十天内从 Trash 找回，归档看板则无限期保留于档案中。但看板指南说明，删除或归档都会移除 Connect Boards 关系。试点清理前应梳理关联报告，并用可丢弃样例检查结果。归档来源不保证所有关联报告继续工作。

sections.title_en: Quote the product, seat count and usage together
sections.title_zh: 同时核对产品、席位与用量
sections.en:
The public Free work-management option allows two seats and three boards; the FAQ distinguishes it from a fourteen-day Pro trial. Paid plans start at three users and annual subscriptions are paid upfront. The returned annual EUR display shows Standard at EUR12/seat/month: ten seats means EUR120/month equivalent before tax. Promotional AI-credit lines affect the displayed total, so confirm checkout rather than extending that example to every account.

Standard lists 250 automation and 250 integration actions monthly; Pro lists 25,000 of each. AI credits are a separate usage measure. CRM and dev have their own sections and conditions. No universal normalized price is recorded. The board-type guide’s general no-board-limit wording also conflicts with the Free cap; apply the specific account entitlement.
sections.zh:
公开 Free 工作管理选项允许两个席位和三块看板；FAQ 将它与十四天 Pro 试用区分。付费套餐从三人开始，年度订阅一次预付。读取到的欧元年付视图显示 Standard 每席位每月 12 欧元：十席位相当于税前每月 120 欧元。促销 AI 积分行会影响显示总额，应核对结账条件，不能把样例扩展到所有账户。

Standard 每月列出 250 次自动化及 250 次集成动作，Pro 分别为 25,000 次；AI 积分是另一种用量。CRM、dev 有各自章节与条件。本文不记录统一归一化价格。看板类型指南笼统的“不限看板”措辞也与 Free 上限冲突，应按具体账户权益处理。

sections.title_en: Adopt a maintained workflow, not just a board layout
sections.title_zh: 采用可维护的流程，而不只是一张布局
sections.en:
The current terms describe cloud services with limited subscription access for internal business use. They retain vendor rights in the platform and restrict copying and redistribution; this is not a source-code self-hosting license. Third-party apps have separate terms and may exchange, modify or remove data according to the configured connection.

Shortlist the product when a team can maintain its field definitions, access model and automation ownership. A simple shared checklist may need less configuration; requirements for self-hosting or guaranteed connector recovery need separate evidence. Validate one successful handoff, one failure and one cleanup before expanding the workflow.
sections.zh:
当前条款将其描述为云服务，授予订阅期间用于内部业务的有限访问权；平台权利由厂商保留，并限制复制与再分发。这不属于可自托管的源码许可。第三方应用另有条款，并可能按连接配置交换、修改或删除数据。

如果团队能维护字段定义、访问模型和自动化责任，可以列入候选。简单共享清单可能需要更少配置；自托管或有保证的连接器恢复需求则需另外取证。扩展前建议验证一次成功交接、一次失败及一次清理。

seo.title_en: monday.com Work Management: Boards, Dependencies and Automation Limits
seo.title_zh: monday.com 工作管理：看板、依赖与自动化限制
seo.description_en: Understand board access, existing-date dependencies, failed automation runs, connection cleanup and seat/usage conditions.
seo.description_zh: 理解看板访问、基于已有日期的依赖、自动化失败、连接清理与席位／用量条件。
secondary_questions: Why did dependent dates not move?
Why did an automation fail despite available monthly quota?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent hypotheses; no measured search volume or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No live board, guest, dependency, automation, import/export, archive or restore was tested. Exact connector mappings, recovery guarantees and performance remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试真实看板、访客、依赖、自动化、导入／导出、归档或恢复。连接器具体映射、恢复保证及性能仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: Checkout-specific seat buckets, taxes, currency, AI promotion, full data residency/security conditions, interface languages and regional availability were not confirmed.
research_gaps.zh: 未确认具体结账的席位档位、税费、币种、AI 促销、完整数据驻留／安全条件、界面语言与地区可用性。
